title: Verify bounded selected-outcome preview composition
preconditions: A completed evaluation contains at least 201 suggestions under an active rule set, with broadApplyAllowed both false and true in separate isolated fixtures.
steps: List suggestions, preview exact batches of 1 and 200 IDs, submit duplicate, mixed-evaluation, unknown, stale, archived-category, non-suggestion, and 201-ID selections, then drift authority before apply.run.
expected: The existing selected_outcomes schema is unchanged; valid previews freeze exact evidence without Ledger mutation; invalid or oversized batches have no partial preview; broadApplyAllowed=false never authorizes implicit or unattended apply; apply-time drift fails closed.
cleanup: Remove only the isolated data root.
